workflows.title: Storage first-access readiness
workflows.decision: Review memory initialization coverage, release and internal old-data reads before first access.
intent_questions: Which region, first masters and target words require initialization before release?
Does the actual wrapper perform an old-data/ECC read during partial writes, and which admitted initialization and mapping epoch make it safe?

workflows.title: MBIST, repair and functional memory handoff
workflows.decision: Review mbist, repair and functional memory handoff through existing correction, handoff and revalidation.
intent_questions: Which test targets, repair mapping, initialization epoch and first functional consumers are independently required?
Which actual native ownership, repair-load, data/ECC and first-access observations establish the test-to-functional transition?
